title: Answer: humans and animals, down to simple ones, and protophenomenally all events

statements.text: Every state and event has a protophenomenal aspect, but subjects with experience are entangled systems coupled to nervous systems. Consciousness extends beyond mammals and birds to simple animals such as worms or jellyfish.

sources.quote: consciousness is present not only in mammals and birds, but also extends to primitive animals such as worms or jellyfish
